Hello!
We submitted the documents online for the B1 visa on the 30th March - during the war. We have heard nothing yet. I'm wondering if we should continue waiting or whether my Israeli partner should go to the office (Tel Aviv)?

Also, we are considering getting married before I enter Israel for our joint interview. Is that going to make things complicated? Or can we just present our marriage cert at the joint interview and change to the married process at the meeting? 

Thanks for your wonderful advice as always 🙏
